game.title: Atlanta Falcons at Tampa Bay Buccaneers

lede: Atlanta Falcons carries the stronger EdgeDesk offensive profile (#23 in EPA per play), while Tampa Bay Buccaneers owns the more favourable defensive matchup (#7 in EPA allowed per play).
EdgeDesk’s independent projection makes it Tampa Bay Buccaneers −2.0 with a fair total of 43.0 — approximately a one-score game, before any sportsbook number is consulted.

The widest measured matchup on the board is Tampa Bay Buccaneers pass offence vs Atlanta Falcons pass defence, which sits −0.108 from the league mean once the two ratings are combined the way the model combines them.
The largest uncertainty is availability: NFL injury report — not loaded in this session.
